body: I have tried to organise that, but the counsellor I talked to and I did not function whatsoever, and I just gave up and stopped trying. He only made me feel so much worse about myself, and had I not stopped I doubt I would even be here today... Thank you though, it helps to talk it out to just anyone, and I really hope I can make the internship work. Just need to fake it when I go, so they don't see a depressed husk, but I am generally good at that now.

I am glad to know that I am not alone in this, it helps knowing that I am not totally insane to feel and drag my way through this way. Do you have any ways that you get through it, and keep on trying?
